raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5012 rows but only 4866 distinct txn_id values. That points to the same transactions being delivered more than once across batches (batch 14 is unusually large at 389 rows). silver_transactions has no deduplication, so 137 POSTED txn_ids appear twice and gold totals are inflated. The fix keeps only the latest delivered version of each txn_id, by ingest_ts then batch_id, and applies the POSTED filter afterwards so a later REVERSED version supersedes an earlier POSTED one.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
